metadata.authoring: Original Greenbox chibi occupied-cube artwork; no external character asset or likeness
metadata.design: Original chibi helper robot: oversized chunky cube head, compact metal body, short sturdy limbs, two cyan square visor eyes, ear housings, antenna and clear chest panels. Visual inspiration from The Touryst: https://thetouryst.shinen.com/deluxe/; no copied game assets, characters or textures.
metadata.source_axes: X/Y horizontal, Z up; faces native -Y
